title: Sindh Land Tax and Agricultural Income Tax Second Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Land Tax and Agricultural Income Tax Second Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

SINDH LAND TAX AND AGRICULTURAL INCOME TAX
SINDH LAND TAX AND
AGRICULTURAL INCOME TAX
(SECOND AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XX of 2002
An Ordinance to
amend the Sindh Land Tax and Agricultural Income, Tax Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 22nd June, 2002]
No. S. Legis. I(20)/2002,
dated 22-6-2002.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is
hereby published for general information:-
1. Short title and
commencement. ---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh Land Tax and
Agricultural Income Tax (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force it
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect from Rabi 2002.
